page.overview:
Who is Albert Atreides?

Albert is a member of House Atreides who was the sole survivor of a hunting trip.

Albert was on a hunting trip with his family and Tula Harkonnen. As they prepared supplies, he reminded Ronan that he'd promised to do target practice with Albert. Ronan said they had work to do first. Tula then had Albert help her and showed him how to prepare the animals they were using as bait, taking care to avoid the poison sac that could kill them.

That night, Tula killed the entire family except Albert. When Tula saw Albert, she told him to go, sparing his life.
